# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged (at least fifty years old)  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v1 c27 P0](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and housekeeper at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with angles and without curves. Her dark hair shows streaks of gray and is kept twisted up in a hard knot behind her head with two wire hairpins. As a small child, she heard an aunt describe her as a dark, homely little thing.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015)_

## Personality

Marilla possesses a rigid conscience, a sensible, practical nature, and a strict, no-nonsense manner. Though she appears undemonstrative, unsympathetic, and prone to harshness or sarcasm, she harbors an unexpressed sense of humor and deep loyalty to her family. Over time, she mellows considerably through her deep love for Anne, though her emotional restraint makes it difficult for her to express her affection open-heartedly.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c8 P41](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0041), [v1 c20 P9](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0009), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046)_

## Traits

- Sensible and pragmatic  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001)</sub>
- Strict and fond of morals  <sub>[v1 c8 P41](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0041), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)</sub>
- Rigid conscience  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- Self-contained and undemonstrative  <sub>[v1 c23 P25](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0025), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>
- Inclined to sarcasm, especially when suffering from headaches  <sub>[v1 c20 P9](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0009)</sub>
- Refuses on principle to criticize ministers  <sub>[v1 c21 P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- Famous for cooking and baking  <sub>[v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027)</sub>
- Skilled at making celebrated homemade currant wine  <sub>[v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise and train Anne into a good, useful, and properly educated young woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## History

Marilla lives at Green Gables in Avonlea with her brother Matthew. Expecting to adopt an orphan boy to help Matthew with farm work, Marilla is shocked when Anne Shirley arrives instead. Although initially determined to return Anne to the asylum, Marilla decides to keep her after realizing the child might otherwise be sent to the harsh Mrs. Blewett. She takes full charge of raising and disciplining Anne, attempting to instil restraint, practical habits, and good manners. Over the years, Marilla comes to love Anne deeply, supporting her education and her placement in the Queen's class. Later, Marilla begins suffering from frequent severe eye pain and headaches, requiring her to seek an oculist. Following Matthew's sudden death from a heart attack, Marilla openly confesses her deep love and gratitude to Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 c36 P32](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0032), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Green Gables, where she was already grown when the new house was built  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Was stung as a child when an aunt called her a dark, homely little thing  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Had a childhood beau in John Blythe but quarreled with him and refused to forgive him  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>

## Quotes

> Unromantic fiddlesticks! Anne is a real good plain sensible name. You’ve no need to be ashamed of it.  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020)</sub>

> Matthew Cuthbert, you don’t mean to say you think we ought to keep her!  <sub>[v1 c3 P56](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0056)</sub>

> I’m perfectly willing to own up that I’m glad I consented to keep the child and that I’m getting fond of her, but don’t you rub it in, Matthew Cuthbert.  <sub>[v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046)</sub>

> I love you as dear as if you were my own flesh and blood and you’ve been my joy and comfort ever since you came to Green Gables.  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>
